title: On the Trail of Tom Thomson
titleHtml:
On the Trail of
Tom Thomson
heroAlt: Canoe as a painting table on the trail in Algonquin Park
fieldNote: “On the Trail of Tom Thomson, 100 Years Later” was my way of exploring his art and his way of working — paddling and painting his way into history all those years ago.
As author David Silcox said to me, it would end up being more of a journey about me than about Thomson. How right he was. That time in Algonquin changed me forever as an artist.
